Wait — "rows_are_permutation_of_ref_rows" compares rows of out (batch rows) vs rows of ref. With batch=3 random rows, permutation of batch rows is unlikely to explain anyway. That metric was poorly designed — it compares batch rows, not coefficient rows. So out differs in values, could still be coefficient permutation within each row (c1) or sign issues.
